title: Absolute purity of the minus and rational motivic sphere spectra for smoothable morphisms between regular noetherian schemes
source_title: On the rational motivic homotopy category
author: Frédéric Déglise; Jean Fasel; Fangzhou Jin; Adeel A. Khan
difficulty_reason: The cited Popescu and prior relative-purity results do not directly establish the smoothable absolute-purity map over regular bases of mixed characteristic. The author proves the characteristic-zero reduction and develops the required exceptional-pullback extension and joint conservativity through continuity and essentially finite-presentation approximations. The complete first equal-characteristic purity argument then closes the reduction, rather than assuming absolute purity as a general six-operation identity.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Theorem3.6(2) only, with all schemes quasi-compact and quasi-separated and regular schemes noetherian, and the exact smoothable-morphism fundamental-class formulation of3.5. Full new characteristic-zero reduction, exceptional pullback extension and joint conservativity, and first complete equal-characteristic Popescu proof retained. Classical Popescu theorem, Morel Grothendieck–Witt computation, previously established relative purity and rational Beilinson-motive purity are explicitly cited existing research foundations. No category-of-Witt-motives identification from Remark5.17, whose concrete details are left to the reader, and no separate formal six-operation corollaries are counted.
